data.description: Calibration of my own criticism: o1's supporting generalisation — that pure coordination failure produces irritation and workarounds rather than topic-avoidance — is unverifiable from here. If it is false, sustained unwinnable memory-disputes may be aversive enough to produce avoidance on their own, o1 loses its abductive edge and reduces to the weaker but still standing claim that the exclusivity of the account's framing is unearned.
